name: obsidian-healthdashboard
description: Health Dashboard for Obsidian: period, migraine, doctor visits, blood pressure, sickness, medications and A1C in one dashboard, with PDF reports for your doctor.

scripts.build: node build.js vendor/period-tracker vendor/migraine-tracker dist && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('manifest.json','dist/manifest.json')"
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/run.js dist/main.js && node test/selectors.js dist/main.js && node test/visits.js dist/main.js && node test/toggles.js dist/main.js && node test/newtrackers.js dist/main.js && node test/bpsettings.js dist/main.js && node test/a1c.js dist/main.js && node test/username.js dist/main.js && node test/order.js dist/main.js && node test/dragorder.js dist/main.js && node test/extras.js dist/main.js && node test/link.js dist/main.js && node test/migraine-fix.js dist/main.js && node test/help.js dist/main.js

author: bearbaitdesigns
